transfer_audit.constant_terms: The constant -zeta'(0)/zeta(0) cancels under subtraction; the remaining elementary logarithm changes by O(y/x^3) for u,v asymp x and is harmless.
transfer_audit.endpoint: For u=ceil(x)-1 and v=floor(x+y), psi_0(v)-psi_0(u) differs from the integer sum on [x,x+y] by at most half endpoint weights, O(log x); v-u=y+O(1).
transfer_audit.height_boundary: With 0<beta<1 and T>=2, the symmetric difference between |Im rho|<T and literal |rho|<=T lies in unit strips about +/-T. A multiplicity-inclusive O(log T) local count gives O(x log T/T), absorbed by O(x(log x)^3/T).
transfer_audit.prime_power_distance: At integral u,v, every distinct prime power is an integer at distance at least one. The source distance term is therefore O(log x).
